units.source_text: 古歌：“口上不言爱，心中恋意浓。

en.t: An old poem says, "Though the mouth speaks no word of love, the heart is deeply filled with longing.

units.source_text: 犹如川底涸，地下有泉通。”

en.t: It is like a riverbed that has run dry, while beneath the earth a spring still flows."
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.
